items.proposed: EGFR_EGFRvIII row recoded exploratory_correlative (required only for the non-GBM NSCLC brain-metastasis cohort); not candidate-matched
items.reason: EGFR appears only in the brain-metastasis pembrolizumab arm ('NSCLC expressing PD-L1, with no EGFR or ALK genomic tumor aberrations'); GBM patients enter without it, so under D31-A1 it is exploratory_correlative, not selection.

In baskets the regimen of the GBM arms is coded (D31-C3); GBM patients receive 'NEO212 alone', so no drug or radiotherapy is given with the candidate in those arms. The SOC partners are given only in brain-metastasis arms.
D31-C3: in baskets, code the regimen of the GBM arms. GBM patients receive 'NEO212 alone'; combination arms enrol only brain metastases from other solid tumours.
PD-L1 is required only for the non-GBM NSCLC arm ('NSCLC expressing PD-L1'); GBM patients ('NEO212 alone for treatment of Astrocytoma IDH-mutant and Glioblastoma IDH-wildtype') enter without it.

MSI-H/dMMR is required only for the colorectal-cancer brain-metastasis arms ('Microsatellite instability-high (MSI-H) or mismatch repair deficient (dMMR) colorectal cancer'); GBM patients enter without it.

items.proposed: not counted for any_molecular_selection (diagnosis-defining; IDH-mutant and IDH-wildtype both eligible)
items.reason: Entry allows 'Astrocytoma IDH-mutant, Glioblastoma IDH-wildtype', so IDH status only defines alternative eligible diagnoses (GBM IDH-wildtype is exempt like the CNS5 definition) and is not an entry requirement.

note: Regimen question settled by D31-C3 (GBM arms: monotherapy). any_molecular_selection now false (D31-A1/A2). Minor, no outcome effect: coder A also listed aflibercept from 'FOLFIRI Protocol (other names: Zaltrap)' (non-GBM arm only); the FOLFIRI description lists only folinic acid, fluorouracil and irinotecan, so aflibercept is probably a mislabel. Harmonisation checked (A6, A2, B7, C1, C2, consistency): no change. Biomarker rows (EGFR, PD-L1, TMB_MMR, IDH) are not mechanistically linked to NEO212, so candidate_matched false is correct under corrected D31-A6.
